frames.observed:
This is a message from the IT service desk.
 On Thursday evening, we will enable two-step sign-in for the supplier portal.
 You will still use your usual password, but you will also need a code from the authenticator application on your phone.
 Staff who use shared factory tablets should contact us before Thursday, so we can arrange an approved alternative.
 Do not share an authentication code with a colleague or include it in a support ticket.
 Instructions are available on the Internet.
 We are holding a 15-minute set-up session at 11 tomorrow in Training Room 2.

frames.name: formal-passage-236
frames.observed:
Attention, delivery drivers.
 Starting next week, trucks carrying electronic components must use .4 instead of .2.
 .2 will be reserved for outgoing finished products.
 The new arrangement is intended to keep incoming and outgoing shipments from blocking each other.
 Please book an arrival window through the logistics portal before leaving your warehouse.
 Drivers arriving more than 30 minutes early should wait in the holding area outside the east gate.
 The receiving team will scan the advance shipping notice at the dock, so keep a printed copy or the digital code ready.
